project: BROWN — Book One feature-film screenplay and shot schedule
instructions: This must be a complete production screenplay and shot-by-shot animation plan, not a chapter summary.

Every 60-second segment must reference one or more source-derived scenes, and each shot must have timing, dramatic purpose, camera framing/movement, character performances, environment, assets, dialogue or action, sound and continuity details.
Every beat must be traceable to production/story_breakdown.json and the source manuscript/story bible.
Do not invent scenes, dialogue, characters, props or locations. Where a story-bible outline needs expansion into screenplay form, flag that expansion and require author approval before animation.
Every character, location, vehicle, prop, food item, environment, weather/sky effect and sound cue must reference a designed and approved asset ID in production/asset_registry.json.
Each segment must total exactly 60 seconds; the complete schedule must total exactly 14,400 seconds.

Each shot entry must include shot_id, scene_id, start_seconds, duration_seconds, camera_plan, performance_or_action, dialogue_or_action_text, character_ids, location_ids, asset_ids, sound_plan and continuity_notes.
Shot IDs must be unique across the full film, and all time ranges must fit inside their own segment.
